survivors.note: outside-spec: moves the saturation point one value later (2^BITS instead of 2^BITS - 1). The count is stored in a full unsigned, so it still saturates before it can ever wrap: no early free is possible. The spec deliberately constrains safety (never free early, leak after overflow) and the promised minimum capacity, not the exact saturation value
